courses.title: Intro to the Humanities
courses.currentVersionBinding: The current provider page gives SDCM-0047 and Humanities 101, and its objective matches ACE version 5 across art, music, literature, philosophy, historical cultural expression and its continuing influence. Liberty retains the guide title Introduction to Humanities for the same exact ACE ID and provider course code.

courses.title: Research Methods in Psychology
courses.currentVersionBinding: The current provider page gives SDCM-0043 and Psychology 105. Its objective and current outcomes match ACE version 5 across psychological research methods, ethical principles, statistics, research design and evaluation.

assessmentReviewNote: Both current course-specific syllabi require one assignment, chapter tests and a cumulative final exam; each component contributes one-third, and 70% overall is required without a separate 70% floor per component. All tests are open-book and unproctored. The current Psychology 105 syllabus explicitly includes the assignment; an older indexed checklist that omitted it was superseded by the current course-specific requirements. ACE assessment categories are retained independently.
